item.title: Version 0.2.2
item.description:
• New icon, "Ring Glow": a tree's growth rings (nature's own almanac, one ring a year) spreading from a warm centre, with an orange dot for today. It replaces the leaf in the Dock, the sidebar and the menu bar.
  • The blue keyboard-focus box no longer sticks to Overview in the sidebar or to the tab switches.

item.title: Version 0.2.1
item.description: • Life Steward is now Almaknack (almanac + knack). New name in the window, menu bar, notifications and Settings. Your data, settings and API key carry over; the data folder moves to Application Support/Almaknack on first launch.

item.title: Version 0.2.0
item.description:
• Goals page: one card per goal with a visual (book shelf, trip steps, practice weeks, meditation days, smoke-free milestones, nights journaled), "Am I on pace for 25 books?" chart (warm-up chart until 1 Jan 2027), and a Books list. Add goals (steps or practice), tick steps, log practice, add and edit books.
  • Health page: Body (smoke-free milestones 1W–1Y, exercise days a week vs 3), Mind (meditation heatmap, late nights vs weekend days off), Checkups (how close each one is, next 12 months; add dates, "Done today").
  • Overview Week (reading this week, how late work ran, this week's leadership lessons) and Month (books, smoke-free, life balance vs last month). What needs me? on Today.
  • Rules engine (tested): smoke slip, work stretch (2 / 3+ late nights), 7 days without reading, reading pace, 3 days without meditating, goals stalled 3 weeks, checkups due within 30 days. Smoke-free counter restarts after a slip.
  • Check-ins now remember more: the book you name, finishing a book, progress on your goals, and "Worth remembering?" facts that go into About you only when you press Remember.
  • Menu bar leaf: today's check-ins, smoke-free days, pages, meditation and the top two nudges, with Check in / Open.
  • Fixes: answer and reply boxes grow with the text like Claude's and never spill past the corners; drafts survive quitting. Own sidebar and hidden title bar, so dividers are one quiet line; warmer dark palette like Claude's. Fewer Keychain prompts (the key is read once per launch; Settings no longer reads the secret).
  • Updates from inside the app: Life Steward → Check for Updates…, or Settings → Updates (checks daily on its own). New versions download, verify their signature and install themselves.
  • Settings: reading goal (books, year, pages a book). People and gifts are left out on purpose (Keshav will design People step by step).
